minor.issue: Only 5/18 demo clubs have crest_is_placeholder=false (sporting-eur, atletico-prenestino, roma-nord, virtus-aurelia, academy-tuscolana). Root cause in /app/backend/app/seed_showcase.py line 81-82: `pids = [p.id for p in players if p.club_id == club.id]; if not pids: continue` — clubs without seeded players are skipped entirely, including their crest+cover+gallery seeding. Task spec asks for 18 demo clubs to have real crests. Fix: hoist the crest/cover/gallery portion of the seed (lines 84-94) above the `if not pids: continue` guard, so club media is applied for every demo club regardless of whether it has players. Also note slug 'cinecittà-football' is stored as 'cinecitt-football' (accent stripped) — the demo asset file is `crest_cinecitta-football.png`, so once the guard is fixed the file lookup will still miss unless the club slug and filename are aligned.

action_items: seed_showcase.py: apply crest/cover/gallery/description to demo clubs even when they have no seeded players (move the crest section above `if not pids: continue`).
seed_showcase.py: reconcile slug 'cinecitt-football' vs asset filename 'crest_cinecitta-football.png' (either fix the club slug or add an alias in the asset lookup).
critical_code_review_comments: cutout.py::_frame — uses `img.getchannel('A').point(...).getbbox()` to trim before pasting; if remove() ever returns fully-opaque output the bbox equals full image (harmless), but the alpha_max<40 check for 'no subject' should probably be `<10` — u2netp often yields a faint halo of ~15-30 that would falsely count as detection. Consider hysteresis.

cutout.py — session is a module-level singleton but not thread-safe; `asyncio.to_thread(cutout, data)` can invoke concurrent remove() calls sharing the same ORT session (rembg is not documented as thread-safe). Under load consider a per-request session or a semaphore.
club_extras.py::_player_photo — has a redundant local `import asyncio` inside the function (already imported at module top).

seed_showcase.py::seed_showcase — description-fallback logic (`club.description or CLUB_BIO.format(...)`) means once a real description exists it will never be overwritten by future BIO template updates. Consider a `showcase_v` marker to allow re-runs (also flagged in iter 28).
seed_showcase.py — the `if not pids: continue` on line 82 causes 13/18 demo clubs to skip their crest/cover/gallery seed. See action items.

rca of the issue: Only 5/18 demo clubs receive real crest+cover+gallery because seed_showcase.py:82 (`if not pids: continue`) is placed BEFORE the club media block (lines 83-94). The intent (skip vetrina posts+shop items for empty clubs) is correct but the visual seed (crest/cover/gallery/description) got trapped inside the same guarded scope. Repro: `curl $API/api/public/tournaments/la-serie-a-dei-bambini | jq '.clubs[] | {slug,crest_is_placeholder}'` → 13 True. Mitigation: split the club loop into two passes — one for media (all clubs), one for posts+shop (clubs with players).
